Who is best known as the architect of the no-dickheads policy in sport?

[Pietersen’s England return is just pure content at a time when cricket needs it | Barney Ronay] While there’s a statistically significant chance it will all go south, KP’s mentorship could be a throwback to better days (https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/sep/15/pietersen-was-the-original-bazball-and-his-return-may-be-just-what-england-need)

At the end of his time as consultant to the England cricket setup Gilbert Enoka praised Brendon McCullum’s incredible work in healing the culture of his team. Enoka is best known as the architect of the no-dickheads policy in sport. This is basically Doctor Dickhead. Dickheads? He’s not having them.
The no‑dickheads policy has never made total sense. Who gets to decide what a dickhead is? By everyday measures most elite sports people would probably qualify. Dickheads are good at stuff. There is no gentle, nice, rational way to become this good at doing essentially pointless things with a ball. Obsessive and hypercompetitive?
